A typical year has 365 days.

The provided text discusses the Big Bang theory, the age of the universe (13.8 billion years), and evidence for cosmic expansion such as the cosmic microwave background radiation and galactic redshift. This context highlights the vast scale of cosmic time, which contrasts sharply with the relatively short duration of a single Earth year, emphasizing the difference between human-scale timekeeping and the billions of years involved in the history of the universe.
